title: Nanu Kanna Naanna – Blessy Kingsley Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: అతికాంక్షణీయుడా ఆదరణ కర్తవు నిత్యుడైన దేవుడా అతి శ్రేష్టుడా |2|
english: Naa parama thandrivi nanu kanna naannavu
translation: O most desirable One, the giver of comfort,
You are the eternal God, the most excellent one.
Among ten thousand You are the most beautiful.
You shine like precious jewels and You are the One from the beginning.
You are my heavenly Father, the loving Father who gave me life.
Your eyes are like flames of fire,
Yet they searched and waited for me when I was lost.
Though I had no worthiness, You received me with tears,
And with Your gentle and loving gaze You drew me near.
Your heart is soft and tender like butter,
And when You saw me broken, Your heart melted with compassion.
You embraced me in the hug of Your love,
And with a kiss on my forehead You comforted me, O Jesus.
intro: Nanu Kanna Naanna is the latest Telugu Christian song written & tuned by Blessy Kingsley, sung by Anand Palivela and music composed by Sudhakar Rella. This song was released on March 13, 2026, through Blessy Kingsley YouTube Channel.
